summary: Describes how subnet gateways can use the Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) to let hosts on connected subnets communicate without knowing subnets exist. This technique is known as Proxy ARP.

eli5.summary: A receptionist answers the phone on behalf of someone in another office, so callers don't need to know there is a second office. Proxy ARP lets a router do this for computers.

questions: how do transparent subnet gateways work
